english.title: Acquire or keeper of relevant explosive fail to provide information to enforcing authority
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person who

(A)_[acquired]_
(B)_[kept]_

a relevant explosive and kept a record containing the information referred to in regulation 35(3) of the Explosives Regulations 2014, failed to provide the enforcing authority with information as to the origin and location of each relevant explosive to which the record related, where the enforcing authority requested it and the name of an employee or other person who would be able to provide the enforcing authority with that information at any time and the details necessary for that authority to be able to contact that individual in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 35(8) of the Explosives Regulations 2014 and section 33(1)(c) and (2) of the Health and Safety at Work Act 1974.

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
